svg.title: GEAR-Nav real-world and navigation qualitative scenes
svg.desc: Real-world GEAR-Nav routes summarized from recordings, with schematic baseline paths adapted from VEGA. The navigation row contains illustrative recordings with manually marked target people. This figure contains no evaluation metrics and does not associate the illustrative runs with the aggregate evaluation table.
